intro_md: Stats define health, energy, and damage scaling across a build. Players receive a fixed number of stat points per level, so spreading points without a role can make every category feel politely underfunded.
description_md:
## Fund the core resources

Melee affects Energy and Defense affects Health. These two core stats control how long a build can act and survive before its main damage category is even considered.

## Choose the damage category you use

Sword, Gun, and Blox Fruit are separate damage stats. Invest around the attacks your build actually uses rather than dividing damage points across equipment that stays in the inventory.

## Read scaling and caps together

Per point records the direct scaling, Max base level records the normal cap, and Points per player level shows the allocation budget. Build role summarizes the practical reason to invest.
how_it_works_md: Affects and Per point explain the direct benefit. Max base level and Points per player level describe allocation limits, while Build role states the practical use.
